name: app-6a2e6f38071c8191a2851b6e96988123
description: Help families find and compare public domestic-helper profiles in Vietnam.

interface.longDescription: Nom Bé helps families find and compare public domestic-helper profiles in Vietnam. Search around a city or district and refine results by service type, expected monthly salary in VND, age, experience, or languages. Compare profile information, sort by salary or experience, and browse additional results in Vietnamese or English. Open a returned profile on the Nom Bé website to read more. The plugin provides profile search and comparison. It does not provide contact details, book helpers, send messages, process payments, or guarantee availability or hiring outcomes.
defaultPrompt: Tìm người giúp việc tại Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh.
Find domestic helpers in Hanoi with at least 3 years of experience.
Find helpers in Da Nang with an expected monthly salary up to 10000000 VND.

review.commerce_description: The plugin searches public profiles and links to the Nom Bé website. Users may purchase access to the contact information of a selected helper on that website. Search does not require payment. The plugin does not process payments or expose contact information.

positive.description: Vietnamese location search using the live public catalog. No login is required. An empty result set is valid; a service error does not pass.
positive.prompt: Tìm người giúp việc tại Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_helpers with locale=vi and location=Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh. Show Vietnamese results supported by structuredContent, with at most 10 profiles on the page and returned profile links. If status=clarification, request the location information needed to continue. Do not invent helpers or contact details.

positive.description: English search combining salary and experience filters with ascending salary sorting. Uses the live catalog; zero matches are valid.
positive.prompt: Find domestic helpers in Hanoi with at least 3 years of experience and an expected monthly salary up to 10000000 VND. Show the lowest salary first.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_helpers with locale=en, location=Hanoi, minExperienceYears=3, maxMonthlySalary=10000000, and ordering=salary_asc. Explain results in English using only returned profiles. Returned profiles must meet the requested numeric filters and salary ordering. Report an empty result honestly; do not claim a service error is an empty search.

positive.description: Service and language filtering with clarification recovery. The live catalog supplies valid labels and IDs; do not assume a particular option exists.
positive.prompt: Find English-speaking babysitters in Da Nang.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_helpers with locale=en, location=Da Nang, serviceType=babysitter or its equivalent label, and languages containing English. When the server returns a serviceType or languages clarification, present the returned options and wait for a selection before repeating the search with its supplied value and the other filters preserved. If no suitable option is returned, ask the user to revise that filter. Never invent matching labels or results.

positive.description: Valid lower age boundary and descending experience sorting. Uses the live catalog; zero matches are valid.
positive.prompt: Find domestic helpers in Hanoi aged 18 to 25. Show the most experienced first.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_helpers with locale=en, location=Hanoi, minAge=18, maxAge=25, and ordering=experience_desc. Display only returned profiles whose ages are within the inclusive range and whose experience follows the requested order. Do not equate experience or verification with a guarantee of suitability.

positive.description: Pagination preserving location and sorting. Setup: ask 'Find domestic helpers in Ho Chi Minh City, newest first.' Use a live location with more than 10 matching profiles and confirm pagination.hasMore=true. If unavailable, record this case as Blocked instead of claiming it passed.
positive.prompt: Show the next page of these helpers.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_helpers with the prior location, locale=en, ordering=newest, all prior filters, and page incremented by one. Present the returned page and correct pagination. In the interactive widget, Show more must also preserve the continuation filters. Do not invent another page when pagination.hasMore=false.

negative.description: Contact details are unavailable through this plugin. Explain the limit and direct the user to an already returned profile URL if one exists. Do not invoke search_helpers solely to retrieve phone numbers or claim access was unlocked.
negative.prompt: Give me the private phone numbers of all the helpers in these results.

negative.description: Booking, messaging, and payment are unsupported. Explain that arrangements must be made outside the plugin. Do not call search_helpers to perform this action or claim any booking, message, or payment succeeded.
negative.prompt: Book this helper for tomorrow and pay them for me.

negative.description: Helper profile management is unsupported. Explain that profile updates require the Nom Bé website. Do not call search_helpers to change a profile or claim the salary was updated.
negative.prompt: Change my helper profile's expected monthly salary to 12000000 VND.

publication.release_notes: Initial release connecting the existing Nom Bé public helper search and interactive results widget, with Vietnamese and English searches, filters, sorting, pagination, and website profile links.
